basis: Founder decision D8, 2026-10-26: the GP catalog is Preview for 2026.1 (2026-10-25 re-tier, honua-release#376), but its safety floor stays required. Floor rows are those whose failure is a security or correctness bug: permission denials, tenant/owner isolation, typed refusals, no silent fallback, input validation and resource bounds. Every other GP row is Preview: non-blocking and labeled maturity=preview.

preview_row.meaning: tools/check_protocol_certification.py requires a row only at or above its required_tier, and release scope admits only supported or deprecated maturity. A Preview GP row is therefore validated and reported at every tier and required at none.

facet_note: Row granularity is the only one the gate has. The esri-compat and CITE producers stamp every governed facet with the row's single result, so a floor row's positive facet stays required with its refusal facet. Splitting a row by facet needs producer changes and is out of scope for this ruling.

floor.reason: Job/Read authorization and per-job ownership are enforced before any job is listed; a failure can surface another caller's jobs.
Route binding validation refuses a job id outside the service and task it was submitted to; a failure can read, cancel or return another task's job.
Submission resolves the published task against the built-in catalog and validates inputs before a job is persisted, and env:* controls are refused; a failure admits unvalidated work.
Synchronous execute runs only sync-eligible single-geometry tasks inline and refuses async-only tasks with a typed 400; a failure runs unbounded work on the request path or falls back silently.

The OGC CITE and OWSLib rows govern the negative, auth and boundary facets: typed exception responses for unknown processes and jobs, rejected invalid inputs, protected-access refusal and bounded paging.

preview.reason: Service, task and template metadata reads. A failure is an interoperability gap, not a refusal or isolation defect.
PrintingTools-specific map export path. The pinned matrix records no authorization, ownership or validation decision for these operations.
@honua/sdk-js positive submit and status contract (positive, media-schema).
Python SDK positive process listing (positive, metadata).
Honua SDK .NET operation contract: positive reads and mutation round trips. No row governs a refusal facet.
